SWAction.doc: An object that represents a collaboration action.

SWCollaborationCoordinator.doc: An object that contains the shared collaboration coordinator.

SWCollaborationMetadata.doc: A model object for conveying data during a collaboration.

SWCollaborationOption.doc: An object that determines how the system shares a document in a collaboration.

SWCollaborationOptionsGroup.doc: An object that represents a group of collaboration options that the system displays together.

SWCollaborationOptionsPickerGroup.doc: An object that represents a group of collaboration options that the system displays together with mutually exclusive options.

SWCollaborationShareOptions.doc: An object that represents the state of the collaboration options for the document.

SWPerson.doc: An object that tracks participants in a collaboration.

SWStartCollaborationAction.doc: An object that represents the first action sent to an app when the user shares a collaboration.

SWUpdateCollaborationParticipantsAction.doc: An action that contains the cryptographic identities the system uses to add to or remove from an existing collaboration.

SWCollaborationActionHandler.doc: A delegate to handle incoming collaboration actions from a collaboration coordinator.

-fail.doc: Reports a failed execution of the action.

-fulfill.doc: Reports a successful execution of the action.

-initWithCollaborationIdentifier:.doc: Creates and initializes a collaboration metadata object for the specified global identifier.

-initWithLocalIdentifier:.doc: Creates and initializes a collaboration metadata object for the specified local identifier.

+optionWithTitle:identifier:.doc: Creates and initializes a collaboration option object with a provided title and identifier.

-initWithTitle:identifier:.doc: Creates and initializes a collaboration option object.

+optionsGroupWithIdentifier:options:.doc: Creates and initializes a collaboration options group object.

-initWithIdentifier:options:.doc: Creates and initializes a collaboration options group object.

+shareOptionsWithOptionsGroups:.doc: Creates and initializes a collaboration share options object with the array of groups.

+shareOptionsWithOptionsGroups:summary:.doc: Creates and initializes a collaboration share options object the array of groups and a summary string.

-initWithCoder:.doc: Creates and initializes a collaboration share options object.

-initWithOptionsGroups:.doc: Creates and initializes a collaboration share options object with the array of groups.

-initWithOptionsGroups:summary:.doc: Creates and initializes a collaboration share options object the array of groups and a summary string.

-initWithHandle:identity:displayName:thu.doc: Creates and initializes a person object.

-fulfillUsingURL:collaborationIdentifier.doc: Informs an app to set up the universal link and device independent identifier to provide to the system.

complete.doc: A Boolean value that represents whether an action is complete.

uuid.doc: The unique identifier of an action.

collaborationIdentifier.doc: A globally unique identifier that the app hosting the collaboration provides.

defaultShareOptions.doc: The collaboration options that the content supports.

initiatorHandle.doc: The handle of the person who initiates the collaboration.

initiatorNameComponents.doc: The name of the person who initiates the collaboration.

localIdentifier.doc: A locally unique identifier for the item the metadata represents.

userSelectedShareOptions.doc: The selected collaboration options from the person who sends the invitation.

init(title:identifier:subtitle:selected:.doc: Creates and initializes a collaboration option object with the provided values.

requiredOptionsIdentifiers.doc: An array of option identifiers that the app must select before the system makes the option interactive.

selected.doc: A Boolean value that represents the selected state of an option.

subtitle.doc: A localized string the system displays to represent the permissions option in the collaboration view.

title.doc: A localized string the system displays as a title to represent the permissions option.

footer.doc: A localized string that provides additional information for the group of options.

options.doc: An array of collaboration options the system displays as a group.

title.doc: A localized string the system displays as the title of the group section.

selectedOptionIdentifier.doc: The identifier of the selected option in the group.

optionsGroups.doc: An array of options group objects to customize how the system shares the collaboration.

summary.doc: A localized string to summarize the collaboration options.

SWPersonIdentity.doc: The unique identity for a person.

SWPersonIdentityProof.doc: An object that represents proof of inclusion to a Merkle tree.

SWSignedPersonIdentityProof.doc: The signature that the system creates by signing the data with this person’s identity.

collaborationMetadata.doc: An object for that conveys data during a collaboration.

addedIdentities.doc: An array of added identities in a collaboration.

collaborationMetadata.doc: An object for conveying data during a collaboration.

removedIdentities.doc: An array of removed identities in a collaboration.
